2024年全国高中数学联赛二试A卷第4题（50分）。
原题：A、B为正整数，S是正整数的集合，满足：(1)A^k∈S对一切非负整数k；(2)若n∈S，其所有正约数均属于S；(3)若m,n∈S且gcd(m,n)=1，则mn∈S；(4)若n∈S，则An+B∈S。证明每个与B互素的正整数都属于S。
我的完整证明：
第1步。由(1)取k=0得到1∈S。我们先证明任意n∈S及任意k≥0，A^k n∈S。将n唯一拆成n=n_0 n_A，其中gcd(n_0,A)=1且n_A的每个素因子整除A；于是gcd(n_0,n_A)=1，且n_0|n，故由(2)知n_0∈S。
第2步。对给定k≥0，因n_A所有素因子都整除A，可选足够大的正整数M使A^k n_A整除A^M。由(1)(2)得A^k n_A∈S。gcd(n_0,A^k n_A)=1，由(3)得n_0(A^k n_A)=A^k n∈S。这个结论对A=1也成立（n_A=1）。
第3步。由第2步及(4)，对任意n∈S与任意k≥1，A^k n+B=A(A^(k-1)n)+B∈S。
第4步。关键引理：对任意n∈S，n+B∈S。令t=n+B，将t=t_A t_0，其中t_A由t中所有整除A的素数幂组成，gcd(t_0,A)=1，且gcd(t_A,t_0)=1。因为t_A整除某个A^M，由(1)(2)知t_A∈S。
第5步。若t_0=1则t_0=1∈S；若t_0>1，因为gcd(A,t_0)=1，欧拉定理给出某个正整数k使A^k≡1 (mod t_0)。于是A^k n+B≡n+B=t≡0 (mod t_0)。由第3步A^k n+B∈S、由(2)得t_0∈S。再由(3)与gcd(t_A,t_0)=1得n+B=t_A t_0∈S。关键引理得证。
第6步。因为1∈S，反复应用第4、5步得到1+jB∈S，对每个非负整数j成立（对j归纳）。
第7步。任取正整数n满足gcd(n,B)=1。Bezout恒等式保证存在整数x,j使nx=1+jB；通过把x,j同时按通解调整，可取x≥1且j≥0。因而nx=1+jB∈S；再由(2)及n|nx，得到n∈S。任意与B互素的正整数都属于S。证毕。

result.statement: ∀ (A B : ℕ), 0 < A → 0 < B → ∀ (S : Set ℕ), (∀ n, n ∈ S → 0 < n) → (∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k ∈ S) → (∀ n, n ∈ S → ∀ d : ℕ, 0 < d → d ∣ n → d ∈ S) → (∀ m n, m ∈ S → n ∈ S → Nat.Coprime m n → m * n ∈ S) → (∀ n, n ∈ S → A * n + B ∈ S) → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Nat.Coprime n B → n ∈ S

by
  classical
  intro A B hA hB S hSpos hApower hdiv hmult hnext n hn hcop
  have hOne : 1 ∈ S := by simpa using hApower 0
  have source_step_0 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ n0 nA : ℕ, n = n0 * nA ∧ Nat.Coprime n0 A ∧ n0 ∣ n ∧ nA ∣ A ^ n := by
    intro n hnpos
    let g := Nat.gcd n (A ^ n)
    let n0 := n / g
    let nA := g
    have hgdvd : g ∣ n := Nat.gcd_dvd_left n (A ^ n)
    have hdecomp : n = n0 * nA := by
      dsimp [n0, nA]
      exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel hgdvd).symm
    have hnAdvd : nA ∣ A ^ n := by
      dsimp [nA, g]
      exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right n (A ^ n)
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime n0 A := by
      have hfac_n0 : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → n0.factorization p = n.factorization p - g.factorization p := by
        intro p hp
        dsimp [n0]
        rw [Nat.factorization_div hgdvd]
      have hgfac : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ A → g.factorization p = n.factorization p := by
        intro p hp hpA
        dsimp [g]
        rw [Nat.factorization_gcd hp, Nat.factorization_pow]
        have hAle : 1 ≤ A.factorization p := (hp.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization).mp hpA
        have hnn : n.factorization p ≤ n := Nat.factorization_le_self n p
        have hge : n.factorization p ≤ n * A.factorization p := by
          calc
            n.factorization p ≤ n := hnn
            _ = n * 1 := by rw [Nat.mul_one]
            _ ≤ n * A.factorization p := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n hAle
        exact min_eq_left hge
      rw [Nat.coprime_iff_not_exists_prime_dvd]
      rintro ⟨p, hp, hp_n0, hp_A⟩
      have hn0fac : n0.factorization p = 0 := by
        rw [hfac_n0 p hp, hgfac p hp hp_A, Nat.sub_self]
      have hpos : 1 ≤ n0.factorization p := (hp.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization).mp hp_n0
      omega
    refine ⟨n0, nA, hdecomp, hcop, ?_, hnAdvd⟩
    exact ⟨nA, hdecomp⟩
  have source_step_1 : ∀ n, n ∈ S → ∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k * n ∈ S := by
    intro n hnS k
    have hnpos : 0 < n := hSpos n hnS
    rcases source_step_0 n hnpos with ⟨n0, nA, hdecomp, hcop, hn0dvd, hnAdvd⟩
    have hn0pos : 0 < n0 := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hn0dvd hnpos
    have hn0S : n0 ∈ S := hdiv n hnS n0 hn0pos hn0dvd
    have hnApos : 0 < nA := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hnAdvd (pow_pos hA n)
    have hdvd : A ^ k * nA ∣ A ^ (n + k) := by
      rcases hnAdvd with ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      rw [hc, pow_add]
      ring
    have hdpos : 0 < A ^ k * nA := Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos hA k) hnApos
    have hAk_nA_S : A ^ k * nA ∈ S := hdiv (A ^ (n + k)) (hApower (n + k)) (A ^ k * nA) hdpos hdvd
    have hcopAk : Nat.Coprime n0 (A ^ k) := hcop.pow_right k
    have hcopAn : Nat.Coprime n0 (A ^ n) := hcop.pow_right n
    have hcopnA : Nat.Coprime n0 nA := hcopAn.of_dvd_right hnAdvd
    have hcop_prod : Nat.Coprime n0 (A ^ k * nA) := hcopAk.mul_right hcopnA
    have hprodS : n0 * (A ^ k * nA) ∈ S := hmult n0 (A ^ k * nA) hn0S hAk_nA_S hcop_prod
    simpa [hdecomp, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hprodS
  have source_step_2 : ∀ n, n ∈ S → ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → A ^ k * n + B ∈ S := by
    intro n hnS k hk
    have hm : A ^ (k - 1) * n ∈ S := source_step_1 n hnS (k - 1)
    have hnextS : A * (A ^ (k - 1) * n) + B ∈ S := hnext (A ^ (k - 1) * n) hm
    have hpow : A * A ^ (k - 1) = A ^ k := by
      rw [← pow_succ]
      congr 1
      omega
    have hEq : A * (A ^ (k - 1) * n) = A ^ k * n := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, hpow]
    simpa [hEq] using hnextS
  have source_step_3 : ∀ n, n ∈ S → ∃ tA t0 : ℕ, n + B = tA * t0 ∧ Nat.Coprime t0 A ∧ tA ∣ A ^ (n + B) ∧ tA ∈ S := by
    intro n hnS
    let t := n + B
    have htpos : 0 < t := by
      have hnpos : 0 < n := hSpos n hnS
      dsimp [t]
      omega
    rcases source_step_0 t htpos with ⟨t0, tA, hdecomp0, hcop, ht0dvd, htAdvd⟩
    have hdecomp : t = tA * t0 := by
      rw [hdecomp0, mul_comm]
    have htApos : 0 < tA := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos htAdvd (pow_pos hA t)
    have htAS : tA ∈ S := hdiv (A ^ t) (hApower t) tA htApos htAdvd
    refine ⟨tA, t0, ?_, hcop, ?_, htAS⟩
    · dsimp [t]
      exact hdecomp
    · dsimp [t]
      exact htAdvd
  have source_step_4 : ∀ n, n ∈ S → n + B ∈ S := by
    intro n hnS
    rcases source_step_3 n hnS with ⟨tA, t0, hdecomp, hcop, htAdvd, htAS⟩
    by_cases ht0_one : t0 = 1
    · simpa [hdecomp, ht0_one] using htAS
    · have htpos : 0 < n + B := by
        have hnpos : 0 < n := hSpos n hnS
        omega
      have ht0pos : 0 < t0 := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t0 with h0 | hpos
        · exfalso
          have : n + B = 0 := by rw [hdecomp, h0, Nat.mul_zero]
          omega
        · exact hpos
      have ht0gt1 : 1 < t0 := by
        omega
      let k : ℕ := Nat.totient t0
      have hkpos : 0 < k := by
        dsimp [k]
        exact Nat.totient_pos.mpr ht0pos
      have hk : 1 ≤ k := by omega
      have hmod1 : A ^ k ≡ 1 [MOD t0] := by
        dsimp [k]
        exact Nat.ModEq.pow_totient hcop.symm
      have hmod2 : A ^ k * n + B ≡ n + B [MOD t0] := by
        have h1 : A ^ k * n ≡ 1 * n [MOD t0] := hmod1.mul_right n
        have h2 : A ^ k * n + B ≡ 1 * n + B [MOD t0] := h1.add_right B
        simpa [Nat.one_mul] using h2
      have ht_dvd : t0 ∣ n + B := by
        rw [hdecomp]
        exact ⟨tA, by rw [mul_comm]⟩
      have hmod0 : n + B ≡ 0 [MOD t0] := (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr ht_dvd
      have hmod3 : A ^ k * n + B ≡ 0 [MOD t0] := hmod2.trans hmod0
      have ht0_dvd_expr : t0 ∣ A ^ k * n + B := (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).mp hmod3
      have hExprS : A ^ k * n + B ∈ S := source_step_2 n hnS k hk
      have ht0S : t0 ∈ S := hdiv (A ^ k * n + B) hExprS t0 ht0pos ht0_dvd_expr
      have hcop_t0_Apow : Nat.Coprime t0 (A ^ (n + B)) := hcop.pow_right (n + B)
      have hcop_t0_tA : Nat.Coprime t0 tA := hcop_t0_Apow.of_dvd_right htAdvd
      have hcop_tA_t0 : Nat.Coprime tA t0 := hcop_t0_tA.symm
      have hprodS : tA * t0 ∈ S := hmult tA t0 htAS ht0S hcop_tA_t0
      simpa [hdecomp] using hprodS
  have source_step_5 : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 + j * B ∈ S := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
        simpa using hOne
    | succ j ih =>
        have h := source_step_4 (1 + j * B) ih
        have heq : 1 + (j + 1) * B = (1 + j * B) + B := by ring
        rw [heq]
        exact h
  have source_step_6 : ∀ n, 0 < n → Nat.Coprime n B → n ∈ S := by
    intro n hnpos hcopnB
    by_cases hB1 : B = 1
    · have hn_eq : 1 + (n - 1) * B = n := by
        rw [hB1]
        have : 1 + (n - 1) * 1 = n := by omega
        simpa using this
      have h := source_step_5 (n - 1)
      simpa [hn_eq] using h
    · have hBgt : 1 < B := by
        have hBpos : 0 < B := hB
        omega
      let k : ℕ := Nat.totient B
      have hkpos : 0 < k := by
        dsimp [k]
        exact Nat.totient_pos.mpr hB
      have hk : 1 ≤ k := by omega
      have hmodEuler : n ^ k ≡ 1 [MOD B] := by
        dsimp [k]
        exact Nat.ModEq.pow_totient hcopnB
      let x : ℕ := n ^ (k - 1)
      have hxpow : n * x = n ^ k := by
        dsimp [x]
        rw [mul_comm, ← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
      have hxmod : n * x ≡ 1 [MOD B] := by
        simpa [hxpow] using hmodEuler
      have hxmod' : (n * x) % B = 1 := by
        rw [Nat.ModEq] at hxmod
        simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hBgt] using hxmod
      let q := (n * x) / B
      have hdivmod : (n * x) / B * B + (n * x) % B = n * x := Nat.div_add_mod (n * x) B
      have hnx_eq : n * x = 1 + q * B := by
        dsimp [q]
        rw [hxmod'] at hdivmod
        omega
      have hqS : 1 + q * B ∈ S := source_step_5 q
      have hnxS : n * x ∈ S := by
        rw [hnx_eq]
        exact hqS
      have hndvd : n ∣ n * x := ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact hdiv (n * x) hnxS n hnpos hndvd
  exact source_step_6 n hn hcop

2024年全国高中数学联赛二试A卷第4题（50分）。
原题：A、B为正整数，S是正整数的集合，满足：(1)A^k∈S对一切非负整数k；(2)若n∈S，其所有正约数均属于S；(3)若m,n∈S且gcd(m,n)=1，则mn∈S；(4)若n∈S，则An+B∈S。证明每个与B互素的正整数都属于S。
我的完整证明：
第1步。由(1)取k=0得到1∈S。我们先证明任意n∈S及任意k≥0，A^k n∈S。将n唯一拆成n=n_0 n_A，其中gcd(n_0,A)=1且n_A的每个素因子整除A；于是gcd(n_0,n_A)=1，且n_0|n，故由(2)知n_0∈S。
第2步。对给定k≥0，因n_A所有素因子都整除A，可选足够大的正整数M使A^k n_A整除A^M。由(1)(2)得A^k n_A∈S。gcd(n_0,A^k n_A)=1，由(3)得n_0(A^k n_A)=A^k n∈S。这个结论对A=1也成立（n_A=1）。
第3步。由第2步及(4)，对任意n∈S与任意k≥1，A^k n+B=A(A^(k-1)n)+B∈S。
第4步。关键引理：对任意n∈S，n+B∈S。令t=n+B，将t=t_A t_0，其中t_A由t中所有整除A的素数幂组成，gcd(t_0,A)=1，且gcd(t_A,t_0)=1。因为t_A整除某个A^M，由(1)(2)知t_A∈S。
第5步。若t_0=1则t_0=1∈S；若t_0>1，因为gcd(A,t_0)=1，欧拉定理给出某个正整数k使A^k≡1 (mod t_0)。于是A^k n+B≡n+B=t≡0 (mod t_0)。由第3步A^k n+B∈S、由(2)得t_0∈S。再由(3)与gcd(t_A,t_0)=1得n+B=t_A t_0∈S。关键引理得证。
第6步。因为1∈S，反复应用第4、5步得到1+jB∈S，对每个非负整数j成立（对j归纳）。
第7步。任取正整数n满足gcd(n,B)=1。Bezout恒等式保证存在整数x,j使nx=1+jB；通过把x,j同时按通解调整，可取x≥1且j≥0。因而nx=1+jB∈S；再由(2)及n|nx，得到n∈S。任意与B互素的正整数都属于S。证毕。

第4步。关键引理：对任意n∈S，n+B∈S。令t=n+B，将t=t_A t_0，其中t_A由t中所有整除A的素数幂组成，gcd(t_0,A)=1，且gcd(t_A,t_0)=1。因为t_A整除某个A^M，由(1)(2)知t_A∈S。
第5步。若t_0=1则t_0=1∈S；若t_0>1，因为gcd(A,t_0)=1，欧拉定理给出某个正整数k使A^k≡1 (mod t_0)。于是A^k n+B≡n+B=t≡0 (mod t_0)。由第3步A^k n+B∈S、由(2)得t_0∈S。再由(3)与gcd(t_A,t_0)=1得n+B=t_A t_0∈S。关键引理得证。
第6步。因为1∈S，反复应用第4、5步得到1+jB∈S，对每个非负整数j成立（对j归纳）。
第7步。任取正整数n满足gcd(n,B)=1。Bezout恒等式保证存在整数x,j使nx=1+jB；通过把x,j同时按通解调整，可取x≥1且j≥0。因而nx=1+jB∈S；再由(2)及n|nx，得到n∈S。任意与B互素的正整数都属于S。证毕。
